market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have finished top 4 in five of the last six seasons (missed only in 2022‑23) and possess a strong, deep squad. Even with a managerial change from Klopp to Slot, the underlying player quality and club infrastructure make a top‑4 finish more likely than not. The market‑implied 52.5% significantly undervalues this probability, likely due to transitional uncertainty.
evidence_points: Finished top 4 in 5 of the last 6 EPL seasons (1st, 4th, 3rd, 3rd, 5th, 2nd prior)
Squad retains world‑class talent (Salah, Van Dijk, etc.) and has added depth
New manager Arne Slot arrives with a proven tactical record and inherits a settled structure
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Liverpool's squad and managerial change
